description: Source code for JIT logging configuration and utility functions in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including logging level management, output stream handling, and node header printing.

classes.name: JitLoggingConfig
classes.description: Singleton class managing JIT logging levels, output stream, and configuration parsing.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JitLoggingConfig.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the logging levels string to populate files_to_levels map.

methods.name: getLoggingLevels
methods.description: Returns current logging levels as a string.

methods.name: setLoggingLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels from a string and re-parses configuration.

methods.name: getFilesToLevels
methods.description: Returns the map of filenames to logging levels.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets the output stream for logging.
